messages:
maria: Heads-up: Deploybot scheduled cross-service push in change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Planned pin order: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Release tags: api@1.12.0 runtime@2.3.1 router@3.8.2 console@4.0.0. @sachin please confirm runtime warmup and kv cache plan.

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight checks queued for 01:50 UTC. 0 blockers found. Will apply pins in staggered batches (5s gap). Posting progress here.

sachin: Ack. Warmup plan: 10% traffic canary to runtime shard group-a for 10m, then warmup KV caches via /ops/warmup endpoint. I'll kick that at 01:55. Not expecting eviction pressure but watching ttl hot keys.

tim: Rollback criteria: error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency >1200ms. If triggered, revert pins in reverse order within 2m. Who has permission to run unpin? @oncall_kevin?

oncall_kevin: I can unpin. Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/release-rollback. Quick unpin play:

```
# unpin runtime
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/release/unpin" -d '{"service":"runtime","version":"2.3.1"}'
# revert router
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/release/unpin" -d '{"service":"router","version":"3.8.2"}'
```

maria: :thumbsup: I'll hold a canary watch channel for the first 12 minutes. Also note console migration has non-blocking DB migration; should be safe.

deploybot: Starting pin sequence: api pinned -> runtime pending -> router queued -> console queued. Live progress updates.

sachin: Warming caches now (started 01:55). Logs: 200 ok from /ops/warmup across shards. Posting snapshots to console channel.

tim: If we need immediate rollback, prefer staged rollback: unpin router then runtime then API to reduce surface area. Confirmed.

oncall_kevin: If I trigger revert, will also mute alerting for the burst and file an incident ticket. Tagging #incidents if we flip.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update release-note with rollback steps and timeline. Post any anomalies here. :rocket:
